name: Spring wildcard CORS with credentials
attack_scenario: A malicious site the victim visits issues credentialed XHR/fetch to the API; the wildcard CORS header lets its JavaScript read the authenticated response (account data, CSRF tokens) cross-origin.
negative_test_hint: issue a credentialed cross-origin fetch from origin "https://evil.example.com" and assert the response carries no Access-Control-Allow-Origin for it

exemplar.explanation: A wildcard origin on Spring MVC/WebFlux endpoints lets any website make cross-origin calls; combined with allowCredentials(true) or cookie/session auth it lets attacker pages read authenticated responses. Origins must be an explicit allowlist of trusted hosts, never the wildcard.
